prompt:

No attack, walk or extra props.

Main idle: sickle wrist rolls blade outward as elbow flexes, lifting hand from thigh to belt/ribs by65px. Buckler arm bends to lift and cant buckler30px then relaxes. Reverse the weapon wrist roll and lower both arms gradually. Preserve fingers around weapon handles and blade shape; no slash or swing attack.

Exactly eight sequential complete poses in reading order, same anatomical size, planted boot line near localy478, generous gaps, all owned weapons inside each cell. Genuine painted articulation, not translated whole-body copies. Transparent gaps and background, no floor/shadow/labels/grid/backdrop.
